blocks.text: Save the dates for the country’s longest-running benefit bazaar, featuring over 600 shops and food stalls, celebrity attractions, festive activities, and exciting holiday finds. As September ushers in the start of the Philippines’ longest Christmas season, the familiar excitement of Paskong Pinoy begins to fill the air. Christmas lists grow longer, plans for family gatherings take shape, and the search for thoughtful gifts officially begins. This year, the country’s longest-running benefit bazaar invites everyone to celebrate the season together as Noel Bazaar returns for its 26th year with the theme, “Rediscovering the Magic of Paskong Pinoy.” Bringing together over 600 merchants, […]...
